# heist_application (Resource)

An application in Heist's testing scope. Creating one adds the URL as an in-scope main target. Heist retains application history, so destroying this resource excludes the application from scope instead of deleting it. Import an existing or discovered application by ID to manage its scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "heist_application" "app" {
  url = "https://app.example.com"
}

# Add an application without testing it yet.
resource "heist_application" "staging" {
  url      = "https://staging.example.com"
  in_scope = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) Application URL. Changing it replaces the application.

### Optional

- `in_scope` (Boolean) Whether Heist tests the application. Including an application starts post-discovery processing; excluding it preserves its history. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the application was created.
- `id` (String) Application ID.
- `main_target` (Boolean) Whether the application is a main target rather than one discovered by Heist.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import heist_application.app 3f6c1e2a-5b7d-4c8e-9f0a-1b2c3d4e5f60
```
